<includeonly>While [[De Agostini]] and Altaya list fortnightly release dates for most of the issues of ''[[Star Wars Starships & Vehicles]]'', their marketing about the release schedule on {{DeAgostini|url=miniaturas-figuras/naves-star-wars|text=''Star Wars Naves y Vehículos''}} and {{Altaya|url=miniatures-figurines/star-wars-vaisseaux|text=''Star Wars: Vaisseaux et Véhicules''}} instead states that the issues were sent out in shipments, like the majority of De Agostini's magazine lines. This is confirmed by subscriber reports on {{Rebelscum|subdomain=forum|url=threads/deagostini-altaya-is-back-with-a-new-ships-vehicles-subscriber-line-so-far-only-in-france.1147242|text=DeAgostini / Altaya is back with a new ships & vehicles subscriber line (so far, only in France)}}, starting in [[May]] [[2021]]. Additionally, while the Spanish and French versions were originally in sync, the French edition shipped issues in sets of 3 starting with issue 11, while the Spanish version shipped two issues at a time. As a result, it can be determined that [[Star Wars Starships & Vehicles {{{1}}}|''Star Wars Starships & Vehicles'' {{{1}}}]] was first sent to subscribers around {{#switch:{{{1|}}}

==Usage==

*{{StarshipsVehiclesDates|75}}
